name: Autonomous Delivery Fleet Hub
prompt:
"Design an 'Autonomous Delivery Fleet Hub' app. The system must process a streaming-style API dataset containing: Drone ID, Battery %, Payload Weight, Target Destination, and Route Exception Flag (True/False).

The UI must feature:

An interactive telemetry grid tracking active vehicles.

A text input box called 'Command Prompt'. If the user types 'Recall low battery vehicles', the app must instantly filter the view to show only entries with Battery % < 20 and trigger a red warning animation on those specific rows.

A dynamic 'SLA Countdown Timer' column that ticks down in real-time seconds for each drone's remaining delivery window."

make it in a light theme (not dark)

thought_process.interpretation: Operations-focused real-time monitoring dashboard for a drone delivery fleet. The user needs high-level command capability ('Command Prompt') and detailed row-level telemetry with real-time state updates (SLA timer).
assumed_from_scratch: SLA real-time countdown logic using setInterval
Command-based state filtering for Battery % logic
Warning animation (pulse effect) for filtered rows
thought_process.skill_suggestions: A specific 'real_time_state.skill.md' would be helpful to standardize how ticking timers and streaming-style UI animations should be handled across data apps.
